name: GBLD-345
summary: GBLD-345 is an anxiolytic drug used in scientific research, which acts as a non-selective, full-efficacy positive allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor. It has similar effects to benzodiazepine drugs, but is structurally distinct and so is classed as a nonbenzodiazepine anxiolytic.

pharmacology.text: GBLD-345 is an anxiolytic drug used in scientific research, which acts as a non-selective, full-efficacy positive allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor.

uses.text: GBLD-345 is an anxiolytic drug used in scientific research, which acts as a non-selective, full-efficacy positive allosteric modulator of the GABAA receptor.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that act at the benzodiazepine site in this way can cause sedation, poor coordination, memory problems and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。以這種方式作用於苯二氮平結合位的藥物，可能造成鎮靜、協調變差、記憶問題與依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。以这种方式作用于苯二氮平结合位的药物，可能造成镇静、协调制差、记忆问题与依赖。

fact.en: Although it is not a benzodiazepine in shape, GBLD-345 fits the same docking site on the GABAA receptor that benzodiazepines use, showing that very different molecules can share one target.
fact.zh: 雖然 GBLD-345 的結構不是苯二氮平類，它卻能結合 GABAA 受體上與苯二氮平類相同的位置，顯示形狀很不同的分子也能共用同一個標靶。
fact.zhHans: 虽然 GBLD-345 的结构不是苯二氮平类，它却能结合 GABAA 受体上与苯二氮平类相同的位置，显示形状很不同的分子也能共用同一个标靶。
